Scale armor
Guard: helmet, masked helmet, body armor, and leg armor.

Plate armor
Captain: helmet, masked helmet, body armor, and leg armor.
Myrmidon and Veteran: body armor.

Available in iron, meteoric iron, and steel, with the standard Forgotten Armory coatings, trim, decorations, and colors.

Helmet decorations
• Communis pennae
• Communis cauda
• Communis pluma
• Communis crista
• Communis Pinna
• Communis Transversa
• Regalis Crista
• Metallicus Laurea (plain only)
• Bear fur
• Wolf helmet decoration

Body decorations
• Insignia
• Mantellum
• Bear fur
• Wolf body decoration

Leg decorations
• Lacinia
• Bear fur
• Wolf leg decoration

Decoration colors
Communis and Regalis ornaments allow every decoration color except none. Metallicus Laurea is available only in plain. Bear and wolf decorations use black, brown, or white.
